review_method: Read full submitted diff, code, tests, card, raw logs, final developer contract and role catalogs; statically cross-reference existing Django models, network projection, effective status, Policy, command schemas, routes and React form IDs; independently hash source and files. No application tests or historical suites rerun.

verified.authenticated_get_and_role_revocation: Author isolated HTTP tests cover anonymous 401, authenticated catalog, POST 405 and removed role 403; static endpoint reads Policy and checks access revision again.
verified.private_response: Wrapper sets private,no-store and Vary:Cookie on returned 200,405,409,503 and caught identity responses; no operational data included in metadata.
verified.shared_writers: All 23 action names resolve to existing erp.service.SCHEMAS and existing React ERP_ACTIONS forms; presets use accepted writer parameters and actual row fields; no generic write endpoint added.
verified.role_projection: CEO8models/23actions/8moneycolumns; manager7models/15actions/0moneycolumns; observer7models/0actions/0moneycolumns. Invoices preserve public code/customer/date/currency; retentions and all finance metadata/actions absent for nonCEO. Observer export endpoint null.
verified.actual_fields: Registry columns verified against erp/network.py, queries.py, corrections.effective_row and ORM models. Purchase status is effective_status; invoice key is invoice_id and status_field null; monetary values remain existing exact decimal strings.
verified.composition: Known immutable dataclasses, exactly one module owner per network model, valid dependencies, selected dependency closure/cycle detection, known writer action mapping and accepted presets. Unknown or malformed BOS_ENABLED_MODULES returns503 without catalog.
verified.read_only: Endpoint builds metadata and performs authentication/permission reads only; no business model, migration, Policy, Decimal or writer changes. Author query capture rejects SQL writes and patches writer/network build to fail if called.
verified.configuration_scope: Server composition is documented as navigation only; it does not uninstall endpoints or alter authorization. No AI automation is represented as implemented.

tests_evidence.contract_change: Second invocation follows root instruction to retain policy-visible invoice metadata for nonCEO; assertions explicitly preserve those four fields and continue denying amounts/actions/retentions. Not a weakening to hide a failed implementation test.

integration_documentation_followup.finding: Architectural proposal still describes the initial draft signature (top-level data_schema/data_endpoint/read_only_registry, one operations module, id_field/columns.field and view IDslist/kanban/map/inbox). Accepted final metadata is nested data, six existing functional modules, key/columns.key/status_field and IDscontrol/flow/network/focus with type list/kanban/map/inbox.
integration_documentation_followup.resolution: Root must align that proposed section with docs/MODULE_DEVELOPER_CONTRACT_UA.md or explicitly designate the final developer contract as authoritative and the earlier JSON vocabulary as superseded. Do not claim this registry completes all Phase1 or seven phases.

not_verified_in_this_review: Merged backend plus new workspace frontend behavior
Real browser interactions, accessibility and responsive layout
PostgreSQL execution of the new endpoint tests
Production/pilot readiness or whole-repository Git identity
Generic future descriptor extensions beyond this actual fixed catalog
